nodes.name: Ashby — Application Feed (24h)
nodes.notes: Pulls the application feed (stage transitions, scorecards, status changes). Replace endpoint for Greenhouse (/v1/applications?updated_after=…) or Lever (/v1/opportunities?expand=stage).

parameters.query:
SELECT
  b.role_id,
  b.from_stage,
  b.to_stage,
  b.conversion_rate_mean,
  b.conversion_rate_stddev,
  b.dwell_seconds_p50 AS baseline_dwell_p50,
  b.stage_sla_seconds,
  b.sample_size,
  b.refreshed_at
FROM funnel_baselines b
WHERE b.role_id = $1 AND b.from_stage = $2 AND b.to_stage = $3
LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Lookup Baseline
nodes.notes: Baselines table is refreshed monthly by a separate job — see _README.md.

VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) DO NOTHING

nodes.name: Dedupe + Persist Alert
nodes.notes: Dedupe key is (role, stage, anomaly_type, day). ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING means a same-day re-run will not re-alert.

nodes.name: Claude — Narrative Explanation
nodes.notes: Cost guard: only runs after the dedupe insert returns a fresh row, so daily token spend scales with new alerts only.

nodes.name: Nightly Cron — 3am (TTH trend)
nodes.notes: Independent trigger for the time-to-hire trend check; runs after the per-stage detector to avoid contention on the Postgres baselines table.

parameters.query:
WITH recent_hires AS (
  SELECT role_id, role_name, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (hired_at - applied_at))/86400 AS days_to_hire
  FROM hires
  WHERE hired_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
)
SELECT
  r.role_id,
  r.role_name,
  AVG(r.days_to_hire) AS rolling_7d_tth,
  b.tth_baseline_days,
  b.tth_threshold_days
FROM recent_hires r
JOIN role_tth_baselines b USING (role_id)
GROUP BY r.role_id, r.role_name, b.tth_baseline_days, b.tth_threshold_days
HAVING AVG(r.days_to_hire) > b.tth_threshold_days;

INSERT INTO anomaly_alerts (role_id, from_stage, to_stage, anomaly_type, severity, current_value, baseline_value, window_end, dedupe_key)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id;
